stringUnit.value: This captured asset will replace the legacy cover only in a newly approved release. This request still needs review. Player access requires an authorized run pinned to that release.
此快照中的资产仅用于新审核通过版本的封面替换。本请求仍需审核；玩家只能通过获授权且固定到该版本的开局读取。
This selected asset is frozen in the captured approved manifest. New players can read it only through their authorized, pinned run. The author-only locator is not a public image URL.
所选资产已冻结在当前捕获的已审核清单中。新玩家只能通过其获授权且固定版本的开局读取。作者专用地址并非公开图片链接。
